## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p1` · `target:v18` · `domain:cli` · `area:api` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T16:00Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1 + `target:v18`:** a `/meta` read serves a `label` nobody authored. Dropping the invented value narrows the `/meta` door's served shape, which is the protocol-first class. Meanwhile the console shows `recheck_gate.default` as a view tab.
- **Why `domain:cli`:** the read path is `packages/rest` (`meta-item-read-gate.ts`, whose view-container slots already drop the same fallback). The single-item and list reads take the same rule.
- **For the claimant:** objectui's `viewTabLabel` must then fall back on its own when `label` is absent. If it does not, file the objectui half as its own card (the self-split rule).

Claim: PM loop round 1 (#23967: the `/meta` single-item and list reads serve a view with no authored `label` without the `label` the read-side translator invents from its name, by the rule the view-container path already applies, on both hosts through the one read gate) · 2026-10-16T17:08Z
Session: `session_018t6a5rvqPRvEDMCVVW9kYT`
Account: `os-tesla` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee from this act)

Scope: `batch` 3. Dev runs in flight before this act: #23914 and #23909. #23181 slice 4's dev run has ended; its PR #23994 is in review. This card takes the third slot. Verify-lock depth at this act: 1 (#23914's run holds it; the queue is empty).
Order, read at this act: no open `p0` or `pm:blocking` `domain:cli` card is in `pm:queue`. `execution-duties.md` ranks `target:` board items above `p1`. Of the two `target:v18` bugs in the queue, #23909 went to this seat at 16:55Z. This card is the other. #23977 (`p1`, no `target:`) ranks after it.
File surface (read on `origin/main` `2e1562091c`; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- **`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`:**
  - `translateMetaDocument`'s single-view arm (about `:2876`–`:2885`) and `translateMetaList`'s per-element map (about `:2823`), for the type `view` only.
  - A `label` the translator returns for a view that had none, equal to that view's `name`, is not served. This is the rule `projectViewTranslation` already applies to container slots (about `:3005`–`:3023`, #22614).
  - That rule becomes ONE module-private helper that all three sites call (no new export). The docblocks of those functions change with it.
  - Both hosts read through these two functions. `RestServer.translateMetaItem` and its list twin delegate here. The runtime dispatcher's `/meta` domain calls `translateMetaList` and `translateMetaEnvelope`, both exported from `@objectstack/rest`; the latter wraps `translateMetaDocument`. The domain file itself is not edited.
- **Pins:** a new test file in `packages/rest` beside the read-gate tests, covering the single-item and list reads:
  - a label-less stored view is served with no `label`;
  - an authored label is served as authored;
  - a bundle translation for a label-less view is served;
  - a translated label is served for a view that has one.
- **One `.changeset/23967-*.md`** (`@objectstack/rest`; see the Clause-② basis).
- ⛔ **Hold-offs:**
  - not `packages/spec` (`i18n-resolver.ts`' `resolveViewLabel` / `translateView`, where the fallback is made: `domain:spec` ground, and a change there changes an exported function's return type);
  - not `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` (PR #23990, #23050);
  - not `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` (#23914, in flight);
  - not objectstack-ai/objectui.
- **The consumer half:** objectui `ObjectView.tsx` `viewTabLabel` (`view.label || view.name || view.id`) still shows the machine name until it gets its own human fallback. The card's Done-when files that half on objectstack-ai/objectui when this contract lands, so this seat files it at landing.
Container & model: `S`-to-`M` (one rule on three call sites of one module, pins on two reads and two hosts), `mode:subagent`, `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (`dispatch-gates --tier` on this surface: no path-derived mandate). The `(narrowing)` face owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review before the queue.
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Basis for the Clause-② line:
- It narrows what a `/meta` door serves. A view stored without a `label` was served `label: "<object>.<key>"` on the single-item and list reads, and is served without one. This is the protocol-first class the triage grade names (`6219439245`).
- It widens nothing: no input is newly accepted and no key is added.
- The narrowing follows the declaration: `view.zod.ts` declares `label` optional with no default, and the read layer already drops the same value for container slots. So the shipped answer was the defect, and no published text promises the invented label.
- The changeset says **BREAKING**, names who reads differently (a client that displays `label` as served, and the console tab until its objectui half lands), and follows the repo's breaking-changeset convention, which its gates derive.
Responsibility: `the REST read gate's view translation in packages/rest, which both hosts serve /meta reads through (this lane) | the spec resolver resolveViewLabel, which makes the fallback (domain:spec), and objectui's viewTabLabel, which shows it (the objectui half) | a console user who sees recheck_gate.default as a view tab, and every client that reads a served view's label`
Thread-read: 6219439245
Serial constraints cleared: open PRs read in this act.
- No open PR touches `meta-item-read-gate.ts`, `i18n-resolver.ts` or `view.zod.ts`.
- In-flight claims: #23914 holds `runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`' body catch-all and the transports' body parse; #23909 holds the dispatcher's `/keys` mount; #23050 holds `rest-server.ts`. None names this module.
